summary_en: The study tests AG-120, a drug taken by mouth, in advanced blood cancers that have an IDH1 mutation. AG-120 is taken once every day of a 28-day cycle, and treatment continues until disease progression, unacceptable toxicity, or stem cell transplant. This Phase I study evaluates safety, pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics and clinical activity, and a primary outcome measure is not stated.
summary_es: El estudio evalúa AG-120, un medicamento que se toma por vía oral, en cánceres de la sangre avanzados que tienen una mutación de IDH1. AG-120 se toma una vez al día durante cada ciclo de 28 días, y el tratamiento continúa hasta que la enfermedad progrese, aparezca una toxicidad inaceptable o se realice un trasplante de células madre. Este estudio de Fase I evalúa la seguridad, la farmacocinética, la farmacodinamia y la actividad clínica, y no se indica una medida de resultado principal.
who_for: Advanced blood cancer with an IDH1 R132 gene mutation.
Able to have repeated bone marrow biopsies and blood and urine samples taken.
not_for: Stem cell transplant within 60 days, or on immunosuppressive therapy, or with significant graft-versus-host disease.
Anticancer therapy or radiotherapy within 14 days, or an investigational agent within 14 days (hydroxyurea allowed).
Heart failure NYHA class III or IV, LVEF below 40%, or heart attack within 6 months.
Known HIV, active hepatitis B or C, or known or suspected active leukemia in the central nervous system.
